Deferring legacy-report routing until separately confirmed integration would add an unstated exception. Mandatory annual-fee routing would contradict the permissive can also wording. These hypotheses lack sufficient source support for rival formalizations. The strongest uncertainty is whether the unavailable launch circular supplies transitional or operational qualifications.
